about_the_game:
Calvin is the sole survivor of a Halloween ritual gone wrong.

His friends vanished, and in an attempt to re-do the ritual to find them, he became trapped in a place where the line between life and death keeps getting blurrier. He will have to travel through different biomes, help local spirits and face powerful entities and bosses—twisted souls who, like him, tried to defy loss but became consumed by it.

Explore a charming but hostile world

Traverse a beautiful and dangerous hand-crafted world with multiple biomes and unexpected twists along the way.

Encounter local spirits

Interact with local spirits to find out about their stories and help them.

Some may help you with your quest of finding your friends...

Fight entities

Face off resentful spirits in fast-paced and skill-based combats. Use your stick along with special abilities to end them all.

Encounter bosses along the way, confront them and learn more about their stories.

Discover the truth

Speak with the dead, complete their quests and help them move on while gathering clues to slowly uncover what truly happened on that Halloween night and why exactly you're here.

name: Curses Demo
short_description: A story-driven action-adventure where you explore an eerie world, speak to its mysterious inhabitants and confront enemies. Uncover the battles those spirits face with grief, help them move on by completing their quests and guide Calvin toward the end of his own journey.
